name: Check
purpose: A compact visual checkbox indicator controlled by a native checkbox input.

api.element: Use a label containing an input[type=checkbox] followed by .check-control__box.
api.accessibleName: Set aria-label on the input when the control has no visible associated text.

usage: Include check.css. See example.html for complete markup.
accessibility: The native checkbox remains focusable and supports keyboard toggling.
The browser focus indicator is retained on the visible checkbox box.
Provide an accessible name through associated visible text or aria-label.
artwork: Uses the existing ic-success-tick.svg path geometry inline; only the copied path fill is currentColor to match the exported white mark token. The source asset is unchanged.
responsive: Desktop and Mobile checkbox tokens are identical; no breakpoint override is needed.
